title: Itervox rules file
description: Layered rules injected into every Itervox agent run: ~/.itervox/rules.json (user), .itervox/rules.json (project, committed) and .itervox/rules.local.json (project local, gitignored). The files are JSONC: comments and trailing commas are allowed.

$schema.description: The schema URL, for editor support.

rules.description: The rules this layer sets. A rule replaces a lower layer's rule with the same id, except a must rule from the user layer, which no later layer can override.

id.description: Unique within the file (case-insensitive). A later layer's rule with the same id replaces this one.

severity.description: must: a requirement. should: a strong default the agent may depart from with a stated reason. Must rules are listed first.

text.description: The instruction the agent is given.

description.description: Why the rule exists. Shown in the editor; not sent to the agent.

scope.description: Narrows the runs the rule applies to. An empty or missing list matches every run; entries match case-insensitively and may use * and ? globs. All lists must match.

projects.description: The project: the name of the directory that holds WORKFLOW.md, or a tracker.project_slug entry.

profiles.description: Agent profile names. A run without a named profile is "default".
